population.span: In a randomized, double-blind, noninferiority trial involving patients with acute venous thromboembolism who were initially given parenteral anticoagulation therapy for a median of 9 days (interquartile range, 8 to 11)

endpoint.span: The primary outcome was the 6-month incidence of recurrent symptomatic, objectively confirmed venous thromboembolism and related deaths.

estimate.span: The hazard ratio with dabigatran was 1.10 (95% CI, 0.65 to 1.84).

ci.span: The hazard ratio with dabigatran was 1.10 (95% CI, 0.65 to 1.84).

analysis_set.span: For statistical analysis 2: from randomisation to 6 months (up to day 180) | POPULATION: Full analysis set (FAS): consisted of all randomised patients who were documented to have taken at least one dose of study drug.

treatment_strategy.span: we compared oral dabigatran, administered at a dose of 150 mg twice daily, with warfarin that was dose-adjusted to achieve an international normalized ratio of 2.0 to 3.0.

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was the 6-month incidence of recurrent symptomatic, objectively confirmed venous thromboembolism and related deaths.

entry_population_reading.span: Inclusion criteria 1. Acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) of the leg involving proximal veins, and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) iin patients for whom at least 6 months of anticoagulant therapy is considered appropriate 2. Male or female, being 18 years of age or older

entry_population.extractor_why: The registry specifies adults with acute proximal DVT and/or PE; its trial title explicitly describes acute symptomatic VTE. The analysis-set restriction is addressed separately.

extractor_mismatch_note: The served HR and CI match the six-month primary endpoint. However, the served intention-to-treat label does not match the registry's explicitly restricted full analysis set: randomised patients documented to have taken at least one dose, analysed as randomised.
